eventMetadata.context_description: No. 1 seed Michigan Wolverines enter the NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 as trader consensus heavy favorites against No. 4 seed Alabama Crimson Tide, buoyed by their dominant 33-3 regular season, Big Ten regular-season title, and convincing first- and second-round victories marked by elite defense that stifles high-tempo offenses. Alabama advanced with offensive explosions over lower seeds but faces major hurdles without suspended second-leading scorer Aden Holloway—out due to an off-court incident—plus injuries to Davion Hannah, Keitenn Bristow, and Collins Onyejiaka, thinning their backcourt depth. Michigan's Winters Grady remains sidelined with a lower-leg issue, but their balanced attack and pace control in Chicago's neutral site tilt sentiment decisively, emphasizing the Tide's chaos versus the Wolverines' structure in this March Madness clash.
